scope: Direct DRT tile writes versus separate tile texture and assembly blit, 60 MP on physical Apple M4 Max Metal
sourceCommitMeaning: 49f5f088 tests both paths explicitly in the same Release test binaries for both DAG executors; product selection changes the default only.
timingScope: One first delivery per route with system caches intact, followed by five warmups and 30 measured. Separately timed phases overlap.
comparability: Fixed graph values, output settings and RAW within each route. Random workflow and graph node IDs are generated independently per run.
retainedArtifacts: 36 files per format and route in each arm. Component renders both formats and their receipts independently of the 032 workbench batches.
memory: Logical reserve for the old DRT tile kept in both modes. Sampled device allocation and process footprint are separate metrics at equivalent milestones. The old pure-frame blit payload is logical, not a device-traffic counter.

cases: bit equality including border tile, partial and zero alpha, nonzero DRT trims and untouched sentinel pixels
known invalid region and input alias rejection
actual cancellation after one completed tile and retry on the same owner

selection: Direct tiles are now default. RAWMASTER_SCENE_DIRECT_DRT=0 invokes the measured blit route when needed.
